dedicated.name: Radgrid's Auxiliary Device

why_by_stat.Resilience: Reduces incoming Critical Damage 1%-for-1%, helping Radgrid survive Critical Hits more easily.

dedicated.story:
"This will serve as the pillar that supports your dreams, Radgrid."

Reginleif presented Radgrid with a new assistive device and offered her sincere encouragement so that she could confidently pass the cadet exams. Long held back by her frail constitution and the scars of her past, Radgrid was empowered to stand on her own again thanks to Reginleif's steadfast support and faith in her abilities. Determined to fulfill her long-cherished dream, Radgrid is resolved to give everything she has and press forward.

lore:
Born as the second daughter of a noble family that produced generations of Celestial commanders, Radgrid mastered martial and military arts and developed excellent tactical insight in spite of her naturally frail constitution.
In comparison, her older sister Randgrid, who possessed a strong constitution and sturdy physique, failed to earn the recognition of her family and subsequently grew more solitary and isolated. Knowing this, Radgrid hid her own conflicting feelings of sympathy and jealousy to maintain their relationship.
As time passed, the gap in skill between the sisters grew as Radgrid's older sister's skills rapidly improved thanks to her innate strength and talent.
During a family tournament to determine the family's successor, Randgrid accidentally broke Radgrid's sword.
The broken blade's fragment gave Radgrid a grave injury she never fully recovered from, forcing her to take herself out of the running to become successor.
It was Reginleif who appeared before Radgrid when she was at her lowest.
Impressed by Radgrid's strategic mind and quick situational judgment, Reginleif recommended her as a candidate for Celestial Guardian.
Radgrid then set out to prove her worth by serving as Freyr's adjutant while striving to find ways to better protect the Celestial Realm. Eventually, this led her to gain access to dangerous intel regarding the Power of Destruction, a subject that is considered taboo in the Celestial Realm.
